dimensions.assessment: Affects urban residents, health care providers, hospitals, and state health agencies across the 50 States, District of Columbia, and U.S. territories.
dimensions.evidence: The 50 States, the District of Columbia, Puerto Rico, the Virgin Islands, Guam, the Northern Mariana Islands, and American Samoa shall be eligible for an allotment

dimensions.assessment: Provides large-scale funding allotments to states for health care improvements, technology adoption, workforce recruitment, and financial stabilization of urban hospitals.
dimensions.evidence: to improve access to hospitals, other health care providers, and health care items and services furnished to urban residents of the State

dimensions.assessment: Appropriates $10,000,000,000 annually for fiscal years 2027 through 2031 ($50 billion total) plus $200,000,000 for implementation.
dimensions.evidence: There are appropriated... $10,000,000,000 for fiscal year 2027... $200,000,000 for fiscal year 2026

dimensions.assessment: Amends title XI of the Social Security Act to create a new federal-state grant program with specific application, allotment, and reporting rules administered by CMS.
dimensions.evidence: To amend title XI of the Social Security Act to establish an Urban Health Transformation Program.

dimensions.assessment: Authorizes multi-year mandatory funding spanning fiscal years 2026 through 2033 for expenditure and redistribution rules.
dimensions.evidence: Amounts appropriated under paragraph (1) that are unexpended or unobligated as of October 1, 2033, shall be returned to the Treasury

missing_information: Specific allocation formulas or exact allotment amounts per state prior to CMS determination
importance_detail.rationale: The bill appropriates substantial federal funding ($10 billion annually from fiscal year 2027 through 2031 plus $200 million for implementation) to establish an Urban Health Transformation Program across states and territories.
